get.x-inactivity-policy: Background reads do not renew. Deliberate Mover-Admin-Activity: interaction requires session-bound CSRF and the configured target authority. Origin is optional on GET, but must match when supplied. Sec-Fetch-Site must be same-origin when supplied. See ACCESS-BOUNDARY.candidate.md.

parameters.name: Mover-Admin-Activity
parameters.description: Candidate deliberate read/navigation only. Omit for polling. If supplied, valid session-bound CSRF and configured target authority are mandatory. Do not require a script-supplied Origin for same-origin browser GET.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Browsers normally omit Origin on same-origin GET. Optional here; if supplied it must exactly match the configured dashboard origin.

parameters.name: Mover-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required and session-bound when deliberate activity is asserted; not required for an ordinary nonrenewing session read.

parameters.name: Sec-Fetch-Site
parameters.description: Browser-supplied metadata. If present on a deliberate-activity read it must be same-origin; absence does not remove the mandatory session-bound CSRF check.

post.description: Job-IDs-only body and frozen reviewed-state context. Per-job occurrence receipts compare exact own-command fields; clear removes only its own records. Completed/null count defaults are approved as skipped. Wrong instance is whole-request 409; stale eligible-state decisions are per-occurrence failed counts. See API-CONTRACT-CLOSEOUT.md.

parameters.name: Mover-Retry-Context
parameters.description: v1. plus canonical unpadded base64url of the fixed-key decoded RetryContextDecoded object. 6144-byte value, 4096-byte decoded payload; aggregate raw head8192 unchanged. Existing instance and ordered selection binding required.

parameters.description: Candidate exact configured HTTPS dashboard origin; reject missing, null, multiple or mismatching values. Never infer the trusted origin from an untrusted forwarded header.

202.description: Approved groups 45/51: valid completed retry batches return 202 even with zero accepted attempts, with actual accepted/failed/skipped occurrence counts. Scheduling acceptance is not transfer completion. Whole-request validation/storage failures remain errors.

400.description: Candidate invalid_retry_context for malformed/missing/duplicate/invalid context or selection disagreement; body envelope still to freeze.

401.description: Missing/expired/revoked admin session; no receipt disclosure.

409.description: Candidate review_conflict for wrong mover instance; per-occurrence stale epochs/count policy remains separate.

431.description: Aggregate head, encoded context or decoded context bound exceeded; no effects. Candidate request_headers_too_large code/body to finalize.

503.description: Storage/queue failure; no fabricated final counts. Preserve original context for retry; prior transactions may have committed.

x-pending: Completed-job retry count classification; cancellation transport replay is separate.
Same-transaction occurrence receipts, bounded storage and partial storage-failure recovery.
x-approved-group-51: After the first eligible duplicate schedules work, the next occurrence counts failed.
Exact transport replay preserves original outcomes for uncleared jobs and never releases a later review.
History clear removes only that job's receipts/linkage, without erasing uncleared-job replay.
